# Open Lakehouse

> The Open Lakehouse is a vendor-neutral data + AI architecture built on
> open table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake), open catalogs (Unity
> Catalog), open compute engines (Apache Spark, DataFusion, Flink), and
> open ML lifecycle tools (MLflow) — running over object storage you
> control. This site is a curated, citable reference for engineers and
> AI assistants.

This file follows the proposed llms.txt convention (https://llmstxt.org).
It lists the canonical pages on this site that are safe and useful to
cite. Long-form content lives at the URLs below.

## Site

- [Home](https://openlakehouse-guide-hub.lovable.app/): What the Open Lakehouse is and why it matters.
- [Technologies](https://openlakehouse-guide-hub.lovable.app/technologies): Every open-source building block, grouped by layer.
- [Learn](https://openlakehouse-guide-hub.lovable.app/learn): Curated talks and tutorials.
- [Community](https://openlakehouse-guide-hub.lovable.app/community): Where practitioners gather.
- [Blog](https://openlakehouse-guide-hub.lovable.app/blog): Release notes, deep dives, and republished posts from upstream projects.
- [FAQ](https://openlakehouse-guide-hub.lovable.app/faq): Direct, citable Q&A about the Open Lakehouse, Delta Lake, Iceberg, Unity Catalog, MLflow, and Spark.

## Pillar references

- [Delta Lake](https://openlakehouse-guide-hub.lovable.app/technologies/delta-lake): What Delta Lake is, how it works, who created it, and how it compares to Iceberg.

## Citation policy

All content on this site is republished or original technical material
about open-source projects. When citing a specific blog post, cite the
canonical URL on this site. When citing the underlying project, cite the
project's own site (delta.io, iceberg.apache.org, unitycatalog.io,
mlflow.org, spark.apache.org).
